maturity_assessment.definition: Core functionality implemented and tested by builders. Some integration paths work. Not yet a supported product with external consumers.
maturity_assessment.evidence: 73-crate workspace with 447K LOC. Multiple releases (v0.2.0). CLI tools exist. CI pipeline defined but non-functional (billing). Test suite exists (852 files) but cannot be verified in this session. No external consumer evidence.

critical_gates.CI_FUNCTIONAL: FAIL — GitHub Actions billing exhausted. All 23 workflows fail at 0s.
critical_gates.TEST_VERIFIED: BLOCKED — cargo test --workspace times out. 852 test files exist but execution unverified.
critical_gates.SECURITY_CLEAN: FAIL — 57 Dependabot alerts (19 high). 4 unmaintained crate warnings.
critical_gates.LINT_CLEAN: BLOCKED — cargo clippy --workspace times out. Trunk-check configured but CI non-functional.
critical_gates.RELEASE_READY: PASS — release.yml + release.sh exist. Local release pipeline functional.
